name: @papercusp/pot-app-seam
description: A host-injected seam for agentic apps that bootstrap one or more pots, submit app requests as durable blueprint operations (keyed, replayable, cancellable, with the app's parse gate on every ready result), and ingest judged pot outputs through explicit parser/storage ports. The package is framework-agnostic and imports no Papercusp operator internals; the host supplies the pot, blueprint-operation, and ingestion adapters.
